tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided subcritical siphon and signed square-root correction numerically, allowing rho to move across the fallback range. Fresh confirmation will test whether this stationary model generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied subtree guidance states that the five pilot rows identify the three-parameter square-root branch, so an additional branch probe is not needed before confirmation.
Pilot gradients are at or below 2.36, and the high-gradient probe is not offered; the supplied guidance specifies the smooth subcritical model.
The observed sink-gradient signature and matched siphon subtree support the gradient-dependent model instead.
